purpose: Authoritative source registry. Every factual claim on the site must resolve to a row here. Tier 1 = the league or the primary record producer. Tier 2 = a maintained open dataset that republishes Tier 1 and is auditable. Tier 3 = secondary/interpretive and never sufficient on its own.

tiers.2: Open dataset that republishes Tier 1 with auditable provenance
tiers.3: Secondary analysis or commentary; used only for context, never for a verified value

sources.title: NFL.com — Official injury report by week
sources.used_for: Official practice status and game status (Out / Doubtful / Questionable)
sources.verification_note: Fetched https://www.nfl.com/injuries/league/2026/reg10 on 2026-11-14 and confirmed the page renders Week 10 of the 2026 season with per-player Practice Status and Game Status columns. Content is JS-driven, so the page is a human review target, not a machine feed.

sources.title: NFL Competition Committee — revisions to the Injury Report Policy
sources.used_for: Exact definitions of Did Not Participate / Limited / Full practice, and Out / Doubtful / Questionable; removal of Probable
sources.verification_note: Full text fetched and read on 2026-11-14. Verbatim: 'Questionable means it is uncertain as to whether the player will play in the game; Doubtful means it is unlikely the player will participate; and Out means the player will not play.' Also confirms the Probable category was eliminated because about 95 percent of Probable players did play.
